comment: runAsNonRoot producer-rule table. Per row: pod is the pod spec's securityContext.runAsNonRoot (null = unset). Each container: kind is init | sidecar | regular | ephemeral, own is its securityContext.runAsNonRoot (null = unset), stamp is the box Container.security_context.run_as_non_root the producer must send (null = no SecurityContext message at all), effective is the kubelet's per-container verdict. podField is the box PodSecurityContext.run_as_non_root (null = no PodSecurityContext message at all). The consumer composition (container stamp OR podField) must equal effective on every row.

rows.name: pod true, container unset: both stamped true
pod true, one container opts out: it is false, the pod field drops, siblings stay true
pod unset, container true: the container carries its own value
pod unset, nothing set: no stamps and no pod context
pod false: every container stamped false
pod false, container true: the container's requirement stands
init and sidecar containers are stamped like regular ones
a sidecar opting out lowers the pod field; init and regular stay true
